name: Trading Mode Type 1 Code
definition: Identifies the type of the trading mode.

QUDR.name: Quotation Driven
QUDR.definition: Members could click When market makers quote continuously,or enter RFQ trading process, and make a deal with market makers finally.

ORDR.name: Order Driven
ORDR.definition: Using matchmaking mechanism to match orders which are submitted by members.

NETR.name: Negotiation Trade
NETR.definition: Members send advertisements, and then other members could enter negotiation trade process. In the negotiation trade process, the member completes product elements and submits, and the counterpart just confirms the deal to make a negotiation trade.

AUCT.name: Auction
AUCT.definition: When issuer issues the deposits, market members subscribe the deposits.

MARC.name: Matching
MARC.definition: Trades are executed through matching system.

BILA.name: Bilateral
BILA.definition: Counterparties neogiate trading details to execute trades.

ANON.name: Anonymous
ANON.definition: Trades are executed anonymously to each counterparty, based on rule "pritority of price and time" to match trade.
